name_zh: 特立尼达/狂欢节/能源：狂欢节共识与能源转型
description_zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥 狂欢节/钢鼓/卡利普索/索卡/印度裔/非裔/克里奥尔/天然气/甲醇/氨/液化天然气/能源经济/埃里克·威廉姆斯/卡马拉·佩萨德-比塞萨尔/基思·罗利/多元文化/种族政治/石油/天然气/转型。核心模式：狂欢节共识治理 — 狂欢节/钢鼓/面具/游行/种族融合/文化认同/能源租金分配/社会契约/转型挑战。体现 M211 狂欢节共识治理 — 以"狂欢节文化融合+能源租金契约+种族权力分享+绿色转型"四位一体，在种族分裂/资源诅咒/气候转型/小国脆弱四重挑战中构建加勒比多元共识范式。
description_en: Trinidad and Tobago Carnival/steelpan/calypso/soca/Indo-Trinidadian/Afro-Trinidadian/Creole/natural gas/methanol/ammonia/LNG/energy economy/Eric Williams/Kamla Persad-Bissessar/Keith Rowley/multicultural/ethnic politics/oil/gas/transition. Core model: carnival consensus governance — carnival/steelpan/mas/parade/ethnic fusion/cultural identity/energy rent distribution/social contract/green transition challenge. Exemplifies M211 Carnival Consensus Governance — quaternity of 'carnival cultural fusion + energy rent contract + ethnic power sharing + green transition' building Caribbean plural consensus paradigm amid quadruple challenges of ethnic division/resource curse/climate transition/small state fragility.
reason_zh: 特立尼达非单纯能源国家，而是"狂欢节融合+能源契约+种族分享"三位一体共识国家。狂欢节融合印裔/非裔/克里奥尔文化，能源租金支撑免费教育/医疗/补贴，种族权力分享防内战。M211 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(牙买加)、M210 侨民儒商(多米尼加)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)，核心在于"狂欢节即文化宪法+能源即社会契约+种族分享即政治算法"的加勒比多元共识范式。
reason_en: Trinidad not mere energy state but 'carnival fusion + energy contract + ethnic sharing' trinity consensus state. Carnival fuses Indo/Afro/Creole cultures, energy rents fund free education/healthcare/subsidies, ethnic power sharing prevents civil war. M211 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (Jamaica), M210 Diaspora Confucian (Dominican Rep), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), core: 'carnival as cultural constitution + energy as social contract + ethnic sharing as political algorithm' Caribbean plural consensus paradigm.

能源租金社会契约：天然气/甲醇/氨/液化天然气/收入/免费教育/医疗/补贴/养老/主权财富基金/赫里蒂奇/转型储备
种族权力分享与政治稳定：印裔/非裔/联盟/轮替/威廉姆斯/潘迪/曼宁/佩萨德-比塞萨尔/罗利/种族平衡/防内战/民主巩固
绿色转型与气候脆弱：巴黎协定/净零/氢能/碳捕获/海平面/飓风/珊瑚/渔业/旅游/能源出口/转型成本/公正转型
区域领袖与加勒比一体化：加共体/总部/单一市场/法院/货币/安全/海洋/中国/美国/委内瑞拉/圭亚那/四面周旋

Energy rent social contract: natural gas/methanol/ammonia/LNG/revenue/free education/healthcare/subsidies/pensions/SWF/Heritage/transition reserve
Ethnic power sharing & political stability: Indo/Afro/alliances/rotation/Williams/Panday/Manning/Persad-Bissessar/Rowley/ethnic balance/civil war prevention/democratic consolidation
Green transition & climate vulnerability: Paris Agreement/net zero/hydrogen/CCUS/sea level/hurricanes/coral/fisheries/tourism/energy exports/transition cost/just transition
Regional leadership & Caribbean integration: CARICOM/HQ/single market/court/currency/security/oceans/China/US/Venezuela/Guyana/four-way maneuvering
expected_zh: 以"狂欢节融合+能源契约+种族分享+绿色转型"四位一体，在种族分裂/资源诅咒/气候转型/小国脆弱四重挑战中构建加勒比多元共识范式，为多元种族能源国家提供治理样本。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'carnival fusion + energy contract + ethnic sharing + green transition' builds Caribbean plural consensus paradigm amid quadruple challenges, providing governance sample for multi-ethnic energy states.
